Somewhere in Bethesda, Maryland, there's a fly you might never notice.
Three millimeters long. A whole world to find its way through.
It searches for sweetness. Finds shelter. And takes a little time to rest.
Every movement is a small experiment. Predict. Try. Notice. Adjust.
You can close the window. The garden carries on. The same fly, every time you return.
An open experiment in simulated behavior, by Christopher Woodyard at Vers3Dynamics.
A life three millimeters long. Watch the fly live.
